rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (18 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MiniDiscs_(Hacked), https://www.discogs.com/release/13747135-Radiohead-Minidiscs-Hacked?redirected=true. Official self-released compilation (Jun 11, 2019) sold on Bandcamp for 18 days after Thom Yorke's MiniDisc archive was leaked; proceeds to Extinction Rebellion. 18 tracks, each a full MiniDisc (~17 min to 1h13m) of OK Computer-era demos, rehearsals and live material; total runtime ~16h19m. The individual recordings within each MiniDisc are not separate tracks on the release.
